verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a self-hosted library whose config lives in code and runs against a database you choose (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL). That implies you can point a test instance at a separate throwaway database rather than production data. However, nothing documents a dedicated sandbox or test mode, and one community user reports that running admin scripts and tests was hacky because of the request-header-based design. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox/test mode or test utilities, guidance on isolating test from production data, and independent confirmation that testing workflows are smooth.
